licence_note: No diff text is redistributed: rows carry counts, file paths, a control-category label and a sha256 of the diff read locally.

separation_guarantee: A static diff review states what changed, never whether the fix works. fix_effectiveness stays `not_testable` unless the finding has an executed two-side PoC (work/patch_poc/index.json) with committed evidence in experiments_v3/: the same valid scenario run on both revisions with the correct violation only on the vulnerable side, on an in_diff finding. A diff review, a project build, or a single-side run never flips it, and no review row earns an L-level claim.
